change: Shared work-unit fan-in stops launching and reducing after failure, preserves the first error even if a later task fails, and drains every started task and boundary callback before settling. This permits enclosing owners to dispose only after asynchronous users finish. A separate failed flag handles rejection with undefined.

edgeCases: run failure with delayed rejecting sibling
boundary failure with delayed rejecting sibling
reduce failure with delayed rejecting sibling
no third task starts after failure
undefined rejection terminates instead of hanging
ordered reduction and bounded concurrency remain covered

limitations: Draining cannot force completion of an external task that never settles; adapter cancellation must settle its operations.
This establishes a lifetime prerequisite; window task inputs and boundary replacement allocations still need ownership admission.
